slides.headline: 6 signs that Trustpilot review wasn't left by a customer
No order matches.
slides.body: Not the name, not the email, not the date.

slides.headline: They complain about something you don't sell.
slides.body: A product, plan or feature that has never existed.

slides.headline: Wrong country.
slides.body: A delivery complaint from somewhere you don't ship to.

slides.headline: The account is brand new.
slides.body: One review, posted the day it was created.

slides.headline: It came in a wave.
slides.body: Several 1-stars in 48 hours after weeks of quiet.

slides.headline: They love your competitor.
slides.body: Five stars for the brand you lose deals to.

slides.headline: Two or more of these? It's worth a second look.
